ImageDescription.value:
First nights in Tokyo was a trip I made in Japan during winter 2012. I had the chance to get unique shots of Shibuya covered in snow and experience Tokyo's exceptional nightlife for the first time.

The video covers a little of every popular places in Tokyo including a very nice bar called the Quest in roppongi. You will see timelapses seen from the mono rail starting in Odaiba ending in Shiodome, the Tokyo tower and Roppongi streets, Omotesando and Harajuku fashion shopping district with the prada building, Asaskusa's incredible temples and much more. Enjoy the trip as much as I did! Filmed and edited by Guillaume J. ObjectName.value: Wikimania 2024 - Warsaw - Day 2 - Why Do Japanese TV Shows Insist on Editing Wikipedia While Understanding Nothing about It

Categories.value: Uploaded with video2commons|Video display resolution 1280 x 720|Wikimania 2024 day 2 recordings

ImageDescription.value: The talk explores the problematic trend of Japanese TV shows manipulating the Japanese Wikipedia for entertainment, highlighting the misuse of open collaboration. It details instances where TV programs, including a recent example involving TV Tokyo’s late-night show, edited Wikipedia articles with irrelevant and inappropriate content, leading to criticism and account bans. The discussion attributes this behavior to a misunderstanding of Wikipedia's role as a serious information resource and proposes solutions for raising awareness and fostering a more responsible use of the platform.
